Green. Done.

## What I changed

The `POST /api/owners` pipeline already let `sharesHousehold: true` requests bypass the duplicate-household rejection (`RejectDuplicateOwnerHousehold`). What was missing was the shared, returnable `householdId`. I added it as a **derived** value rather than stored state, so two owners at the same last name + address inherently resolve to the same id.

Three files touched, each a small cohesive unit:

1. **`HouseholdId.java`** (new) — a tiny stateless helper that hashes the owner's normalized last name + address (same case-insensitive, whitespace-collapsed grouping `RejectDuplicateOwnerHousehold` uses) into a stable hex identifier. New class ⇒ no surrounding class complexity to carry.

2. **`OwnerMapper.java`** — one `@Mapping` line emitting `householdId` into the response DTO. No method body grew.
